title: Pullback component of dense-open cohomology comparison
statement: For the data of lem-pbc-s2-dense-open-high-cohomology, every open-immersion pullback of the counit map induces a bijection on H^2.

proof.text: Pull the same open-closed short exact sequence back along an arbitrary open immersion. The inverse image of the closed complement is again a finite union of algebraically closed points, so the same exactness, finite-direct-image comparison, and zero-dimensional vanishing make the adjacent H^1 and H^2 terms vanish. The long exact sequence and naturality identify the resulting map with the displayed pullback of the counit in degree two.

lean.statement:
theorem dense_open_high_cohomology_pullback (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    let ε := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).counit.app F)
    ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (a : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion a],
      Function.Bijective
        (Sheaf.H.map (((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map ε) 2)
